parsed.brief_reason: The patch adds null-checking that throws IllegalArgumentException, which is unrelated to the actual bug being fixed (the methods should delegate to parent plots). The null checks are added at the wrong locations (after logic completion) and don't address the core issue that getDomainAxisIndex lacks the parent delegation logic that getRangeAxisIndex has. This is overfitting to pass tests rather than fixing the underlying bug.
